items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard Ornette. Not at the Vanguard. I’m trying to think. It was some theater.

ctx.x: Yeah. Revlon and others that said that they would not sponsor his show, because of that reason. We see that shortsightedness has come to pass in recent years about that too . . . I just wanted . . . because that whole lineage came through there. What I’d like to do is now, having touched up on that, exciting things of Art Blakey or people like that . . . we mentioned Bobby and Horace. Let’s jump back up again to 1959, 1960, when another exciting quartet arrives in New York and makes quite a splash that carries…
I knew you were going to talk about Ornette. Yeah.
Did you hear that group in person? I know Milt Jackson told me they . . . many times the Modern Jazz Quartet would work opposite Ornette’s quartet.
